text:
alina: kicking off v3.2.2 phased rollout. starting with a US micro-canary (5%). aim is to validate latency fixes and reranker seed bug patch.
deploy-bot: deploy started slice=us percent=5 model=redwood-v3.2.2 image=sha256:ef12be90 deploy_id=deploy-5201234567
rory: quick pool check — which GPU pools get the canary?
belle: US will use pool-a100-prod (primary) and pool-t4-spot (fallback). expected canary qps ~120.
cm-sre: checked 5m ago: pool-a100-prod free_nodes=12, avg_gpu_util=32%. t4-spot free_nodes=4. thermal margin good for 40m. baseline p95=110ms.
platform-bot: FYI routing default allows cross-region failover to EU. if we need strict isolation add region_strict: true.
alina: yes keep cross-region disabled for this canary. adding strict region pin now.
platform-bot: update applied:
```
routes:
  canary_policy:
    region_strict: true
    pinned_model: redwood-v3.2.2
```

alina: proposed rollback triggers:
- sustained error_rate >= 1% for 4m
- p95 latency > baseline + 180ms for 5m
- new 5xx spike > 2x baseline for 3m
- automated schema_mismatch health-check fails
ops-oncall: add: abort if any client-facing evals show generation truncation > 2% vs baseline.

deploy-bot: auto-progress schedule: 5% -> 20% at +10m -> 50% at +30m if green.
rory: can someone run the rerank smoke? I saw slight score skew in canary staging last night.
cm-sre: running smoke now: `POST https://staging-internal/score -d '{"q":"test rerank"}'`
cm-sre: smoke result: 200 OK, sample rank delta within threshold. no schema diffs. p50=95ms p95=125ms.
alina: good. proceed to 20% in 6m. belle, tag release notes with the runtime change and seed fix?
belle: notes drafted: "v3.2.2 — reranker seed fix; minor latency improvements; safer batching" -> posted to #releases with link https://go/releases/3.2.2

(7m later)
deploy-bot: progressed to 20% at 5201234629
cm-sre: metrics look ok. p95=118ms, errors=0.2%. no traffic spillover to EU.
ops-oncall: noticed one pod OOM in t4 fallback at +5m but it was trace isolate (restarted) and no 5xx for clients. autoscaler increased nodes +1.
alina: note that if we hold >45m at 50% we'll pre-warm EU pool to 3 nodes to reduce cold-start risk. platform-bot, add warmup trigger rule.
platform-bot: warmup rule added: prewarm_eu_when_hold_at_50m_gt_45m -> nodes=3

rory: timeline request — EU canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, APAC 11:00 UTC?
alina: agree. tag CS and infra for window ops.
ops-oncall: setting pager thresholds: p95 alert > 350ms, error_rate > 1% sustained 3m. I'll monitor.

deploy-bot: progressed to 50% at 5201234710
cm-sre: holding. live telemetry shows stable latencies p95=125ms, errors 0.35%. throughput steady.
belle: quick flag for release: customer-facing feature gate is still off, so behavior change limited.

(Hold window)
ops-oncall: at +12m saw transient queue rise on fallback pool but autoscaler handled it. no customer impact.
alina: thanks. unless any objection we'll schedule EU canary for 03:00 UTC tomorrow with the same safety checks and rollback rules.
rory: no objections. suggest we keep EU canary region_strict=false to allow controlled overflow if EU pool insufficient (we can flip).
alina: prefer same strictness for parity. we can allow overflow only on manual approval.
platform-bot: scheduled EU canary at 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z and APAC at 2026-03-22T11:00:00Z.

(End)
ops-oncall: final: rollout in US stable for now. recommend follow same prewarm+hold cadence for EU/APAC. will open an incident channel if rollback triggers occur.
alina: thanks all. closing thread; will post follow-up once EU canary begins. :white_check_mark:
